title: A DOD official says xAI has agreed to let the military use Grok in classified systems and agreed to the "all lawful use" standard, which Anthropic has refused (Axios)
summary: Axios: A DOD official says xAI has agreed to let the military use Grok in classified systems and agreed to the “all lawful use” standard, which Anthropic has refused — But the Pentagon is threatening Anthropic in a dispute over safeguards and may soon need a replacement.
